ComponentDescription: Polls the RDKMatterControl thing shadow for desired.command, forwards it to the Matter hub CGI, publishes the outcome to rdk/matter/device/control/result, then clears the shadow.

Run.Script:
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/bin:/opt/usr/bin:$PATH"
echo "[matter-devicecontrol] started: thing=$CONTROL_THING result=$RESULT_TOPIC"
while true; do
  rm -f /tmp/rdk_matter_ctrl_shadow.json
  curl -s --tlsv1.2 --cacert "$ROOT_CA" --cert "$CERT_PATH" --key "$KEY_PATH" "$AWS_ENDPOINT/things/$CONTROL_THING/shadow" -o /tmp/rdk_matter_ctrl_shadow.json
  CMD_JSON=$(python3 -c "
import json
try:
    d = json.load(open('/tmp/rdk_matter_ctrl_shadow.json'))
    c = d.get('state', {}).get('desired', {}).get('command')
    if isinstance(c, dict):
        print(json.dumps(c, separators=(',', ':')))
except Exception:
    pass
")
  if [ -n "$CMD_JSON" ]; then
    echo "[matter-devicecontrol] command: $CMD_JSON"
    REQUEST_ID=$(echo "$CMD_JSON" | python3 -c "import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('requestId', ''))")
    HUB_PAYLOAD=$(echo "$CMD_JSON" | python3 -c "
import sys, json
c = json.load(sys.stdin)
c.pop('requestId', None)
c.setdefault('cmd', 'CONTROL_DEVICE')
print(json.dumps(c, separators=(',', ':')))
")
    echo "[matter-devicecontrol] hub query: $HUB_PAYLOAD -> $HUB_API"
    rm -f /tmp/rdk_matter_ctrl_result.json
    curl -s -G -X POST --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 60 --data-urlencode "$HUB_PAYLOAD" "$HUB_API" -o /tmp/rdk_matter_ctrl_result.json
    RESULT=$(REQUEST_ID="$REQUEST_ID" python3 -c "
import json, os
try:
    hub = json.load(open('/tmp/rdk_matter_ctrl_result.json'))
    ok = True
except Exception:
    hub = None
    ok = False
print(json.dumps({'requestId': os.environ.get('REQUEST_ID', ''), 'success': ok, 'hubResponse': hub}, separators=(',', ':')))
")
    curl -s --tlsv1.2 --cacert "$ROOT_CA" --cert "$CERT_PATH" --key "$KEY_PATH" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$RESULT" "$AWS_ENDPOINT/topics/$RESULT_TOPIC?qos=1" > /dev/null
    echo "[matter-devicecontrol] result published to $RESULT_TOPIC"
    curl -s --tlsv1.2 --cacert "$ROOT_CA" --cert "$CERT_PATH" --key "$KEY_PATH" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"state":{"desired":{"command":null}}}' "$AWS_ENDPOINT/things/$CONTROL_THING/shadow" > /dev/null
    echo "[matter-devicecontrol] shadow cleared"
  fi
  sleep "$POLL_SECONDS"
done
